Oneliner

Demonstrate CubeSat platform technologies and energy dissipation experiment. Backup model of CP2.
Description

The satellite launched under the name CP4 is the backup flight model of CP2. Energy dissipation experiment as well as a field-test of what the team has dubbed the CP Bus. CP2 marks our first attempt at “standardizing” a CubeSat bus to enable easier integration of a wide variety of payloads.

Failure cause C&DH processor lock-up issue.
Notes

Reflight of the CP2 mission using the backup flight model.
